title: devinmonitor snapshot
description: Machine-readable snapshot emitted by the `devinmonitor` CLI (`devinmonitor snapshot --once --output json`) for scripts, status bars and CI. The document is a strict machine contract: every object forbids unknown properties, and a field that Go marshals without `omitempty` is required here. This schema mirrors the frozen Go structs field-for-field; it is generated to match them, so a breaking change to either side requires bumping `schemaVersion`.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this snapshot document format. Starts at 1 and is incremented on any breaking change to the shape of the document, so consumers can branch on it before parsing the rest.

generatedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp, in UTC, at which the snapshot was produced. Used by consumers to detect a frozen or stale producer.

status.description: Overall, pre-computed verdict for the whole snapshot (not per window), suitable for direct use as a process exit code and status-bar text.

limits.description: Per-window usage and limit information, keyed by window name. `five_hour` is the conventional key for the rolling five-hour window; `seven_day` is the conventional key for the rolling weekly window. Additional keys are allowed as long as they follow the `propertyNames` pattern, and every value has the same `Window` shape.

propertyNames.description: Window key. The documented names are `five_hour` (the conventional key for the rolling five-hour window), `seven_day`, `monthly`, `daily`, `session` and `weekly`; the generic branch also permits any other lowercase snake_case identifier of up to 64 characters, so new windows can be added without a schema change.

breakdown.description: Cost, token and session aggregates for the current snapshot period, including the per-model breakdown table.

statusBlock.description: Pre-computed status verdict for the whole snapshot.

code.description: Semantic status code, also used as the process exit code when run with `--exit-code`: 0 = ok (usage normal), 10 = near_limit (usedPercentage >= warning threshold, default 80), 11 = limit_hit (usedPercentage >= 100 or the upstream explicitly flagged an overage), 20 = indeterminate / no active session (usage could not be determined), 30 = no data or config error (usage database missing or unreadable, invalid configuration).

label.description: Human-readable label matching `code`: `ok`, `near_limit`, `limit_hit`, `indeterminate` or `no_active_session`. Both `indeterminate` and `no_active_session` correspond to code 20.

window.description: Usage and limit state for one usage window (e.g. `five_hour`). Nullable numeric fields are `null` when the value is unknown or was discarded by defensive sanitisation (NaN, infinite, implausibly out-of-range or epoch-scale values), so consumers must treat `null` as "unknown" rather than zero.

usedPercentage.description: Share of the window's limit already consumed, as a percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive (slightly over 100 from upstream is clamped to 100). `null` when no limit is configured or the value is unknown.

tokensUsed.description: Tokens consumed inside this window. `null` when unknown.

tokenLimit.description: Token budget for this window, from configuration or the upstream plan. `null` when no limit is configured, in which case no percentage or pace is emitted.

acuUsed.description: ACU (Devin's account credit unit) consumed inside this window. `null` when unknown or when the plan does not account in ACU.

acuLimit.description: ACU budget for this window. `null` when no ACU limit is configured.

resetsAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp at which this window resets. `null` when the reset time is unknown.

resetsAtEpoch.description: Unix epoch seconds for the same reset instant as `resetsAt`, provided for consumers that prefer an integer. `null` when the reset time is unknown.

source.description: Where the values in this window were read from.

confidence.description: How much this window's numbers can be trusted. `official` means the value came from Devin's own credit/ACU accounting; `estimated` means the number was derived from token pricing rather than the tool's own accounting (local math over the Devin database); `unknown` means no usable provenance could be established and the numbers should be treated as a guess.

stale.description: True when the underlying upstream capture exceeded its 600s TTL (OfficialTTLSeconds): the snapshot is still emitted for consumers, but the upstream accounting has been downgraded to a local estimate and must not be treated as current.

pace.description: Optional consumption-pace comparison against elapsed window time. Absent when no limit is configured or the value could not be computed.

forecast.description: Optional projection of when this window's limit will be exhausted. Absent when no limit is configured, the window is not burning, or the projection could not be computed.

source.description: Provenance of the raw values that produced a window.

kind.description: Origin of the values: `devin_db` = read from the local Devin CLI database, `statusline` = captured from an upstream status-line payload on stdin (subject to the 600s TTL), `config` = supplied by devinmonitor configuration.

confidence.description: Trust level for a group of numbers, using the vocabulary already established by the tool's provenance helpers. `official` = taken from Devin's own accounting (credit/ACU). `estimated` = derived from token pricing rather than the tool's own credit/ACU accounting, i.e. computed locally from tokens and a price table. `unknown` = no usable provenance. Separate from this enum value, the presentation layer must render a literal `(estimated)` suffix on any number whose confidence is not `official` (so both `estimated` and `unknown` are suffixed); that suffix is a display convention, not an enum value.

pace.description: Comparison between how much of the window's budget has been consumed and how much of the window's clock has elapsed (delta = usedPercentage - elapsedPercentage, tolerance 10 points).

label.description: Pace verdict, where the parenthesised note is the compared direction: `on track` = consumption within tolerance of elapsed time, `slow down` = burning faster than the window elapses (delta > +10 points), `speed up` = burning slower than the window elapses (delta < -10 points), `unknown` = not enough information.

usedPercentage.description: Share of the limit consumed at snapshot time, as a percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive, mirroring `Window.usedPercentage`. `null` when unknown.

elapsedPercentage.description: Share of the window's duration that has already elapsed, as a percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive. `null` when the window bounds are unknown.

forecast.description: Projection of when the current window's limit will be reached, based on the current burn rate.

exhaustedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp at which the limit is projected to be exhausted. `null` when no projection exists.

display.description: Human-readable form of `exhaustedAt` for direct rendering (for example `today 14:30 (estimated)`). When present it always contains the literal `(estimated)` suffix, because a projection is never official. `null` when there is nothing to display.

breakdown.description: Aggregate cost, token and session statistics for the snapshot period, plus the per-model rows behind them.

byModel.description: Per-model usage rows, ordered by the producer (typically largest share first). Empty when no usage was recorded.

acu.description: True when ACU accounting is in use for this plan, i.e. the ACU figures in `limits` are meaningful.

costProvenance.description: Trust level of the cost figures in this breakdown. `official` = reported by Devin's own accounting; `estimated` = derived from token pricing rather than the tool's own accounting; `unknown` = no usable provenance. On a free-tier plan, costs are legitimately 0.0 with any provenance.

todayCost.description: Cost attributed to the current local day, in the configured currency (0.0 on a free-tier plan).

weekCost.description: Cost attributed to the current week, in the configured currency (0.0 on a free-tier plan).

monthCost.description: Cost attributed to the current calendar month, in the configured currency (0.0 on a free-tier plan).

totalCost.description: All-time cost across the analysed database, in the configured currency (0.0 on a free-tier plan).

totalSessions.description: Number of sessions recorded in the analysed database.

totalRequests.description: Total number of model requests, the sum of `requests` across `byModel`.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens counted for the period (input + output, per the same convention as `share`).

activeSessions.description: Number of sessions considered active at `generatedAt`.

modelRow.description: Usage attributed to a single model.

model.description: Model identifier as recorded in the Devin CLI usage database.

inputTokens.description: Uncached prompt (input) tokens sent to this model.

outputTokens.description: Completion (output) tokens produced by this model.

cacheReadTokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prompt cache for this model.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Prompt tokens written into the prompt cache for this model.

requests.description: Number of model requests attributed to this model.

cost.description: Cost attributed to this model in the configured currency (0.0 on a free-tier plan).

share.description: This model's percentage of the total (input + output) tokens across all rows, between 0 and 100 inclusive; the shares of all rows sum to approximately 100.
